name: Staging Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - staging
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy_staging:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
      
      - name: Install Heroku CLI
        run: curl https://cli-assets.heroku.com/install.sh | sh

      - name: Heroku Login
        env:
          HEROKU_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.HEROKU_API_KEY }}
        run: heroku auth:token

      - name: Push to Heroku
        env:
          HEROKU_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.HEROKU_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          git remote add heroku https://heroku:${{ secrets.HEROKU_API_KEY }}@git.heroku.com/${{ secrets.HEROKU_STAGING_APP_NAME }}.git || true
          git push heroku HEAD:main --force

      - name: Run Migrations
        run: heroku run python manage.py migrate -a ${{ secrets.HEROKU_STAGING_APP_NAME }}

      - name: Load Fixtures
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.STAGING_DB_URL }}
        run: |
          heroku run python manage.py loaddata account_group.json -a ${{ secrets.HEROKU_STAGING_APP_NAME }}
          heroku run python manage.py loaddata account.json -a ${{ secrets.HEROKU_STAGING_APP_NAME }}
          heroku run python manage.py loaddata artwork_categories.json -a ${{ secrets.HEROKU_STAGING_APP_NAME }}
          heroku run python manage.py loaddata artwork_framing_options.json -a ${{ secrets.HEROKU_STAGING_APP_NAME }}
          heroku run python manage.py loaddata artwork.json -a ${{ secrets.HEROKU_STAGING_APP_NAME }}
          heroku run python manage.py loaddata photo.json -a ${{ secrets.HEROKU_STAGING_APP_NAME }}
          heroku run python manage.py loaddata profiles.json -a ${{ secrets.HEROKU_STAGING_APP_NAME }}

      - name: Collect Static Files
        run: heroku run python manage.py collectstatic --noinput -a ${{ secrets.HEROKU_STAGING_APP_NAME }}
